description: Compute EU import duty from TARIC for a declarable 10-digit code, as_of (YYYY-MM-DD, mandatory), origin (ISO country) and customs_value in EUR, with quantities by TARIC unit code (e.g. {"DTN": 12.5}) where a specific duty needs them. Every measure on the code for that origin gets a state: computed, insufficient_data (condition, quota balance, additional code, Meursing, entry price, MIN / MAX, or a quantity named in missing_inputs) or not_applicable. Third-country duty first; each other rate is its own line saying what it requires; no total. Trade-defence duties are listed, never computed. For the measures alone use eu_tariff_lookup; for the UK use uk_duty_calculator. No VAT, excise or currency conversion (EUR only); one monthly TARIC extraction, as_of must be its reference date. Reference, not advice. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

as_of.description: Date the duty is computed for, YYYY-MM-DD. Required; must be the reference date of the TARIC extraction (a refusal names it).

code.description: Declarable TARIC code, 10 digits (an 8-digit CN code is read as its 10-digit form). Required.

currency.description: EUR (the default and the only one accepted: no currency is converted).

customs_value.description: Customs value in EUR, a positive number. Required.

origin.description: Country of origin, ISO 3166 alpha-2 (e.g. CN, US, TR). Required.

quantities.description: Quantities by TARIC unit code for specific or compound duties, e.g. {"DTN": 12.5} (12.5 × 100 kg), {"HLT": 4}, {"NAR": 100}, {"DTN/E": 3}. A specific duty without its quantity is listed as insufficient_data and named in missing_inputs.

title: EU Duty Calculator (TARIC)
